audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart was effectively inverted against the content layer and the packet: full read Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan/Skill/Skill/Skill, content and packet read Orianna/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akshan/Akshan/Akshan. All seven rows disagreed.
audit.why: Heroic Swing does not exist until level 3 and is 18s at rank 1, so Orianna owns level 1 and the 2-5 window is a skillshot trade. Comeuppance at 6 is a 2500-range missing-health execute on 100s, and the swing dodges Shockwave, so the back half is his.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides aligned to the content/packet values, with every why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes described Orianna spiking at 6 and gave two magnitudes with no source ('doubles your lane presence', 'a third of a health bar'). Level 6 is Akshan's spike in this lane.
audit.why: Comeuppance stores bullets and scales on missing health at 2500 range on a 100/85/70 cooldown — it is the timing that changes the lane, not Shockwave.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around Lost Chapter, his Comeuppance flip, and Luden's restoring shove tempo.

audit.whatIsWrong: Going Rogue's camouflage was never mentioned, breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it, and Dirty Fighting's every-third-hit shield — the reason chip poke does not accumulate here — was absent.
audit.why: Orianna has no reveal in her kit, so a Control Ward and a sweeper are the only answers to Going Rogue (18/14/10/6/2s and it reaches rank-5 near-zero). Dirty Fighting shields him on every third hit from attacks or abilities, which is why drip poke fails and burst trades work.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now states the camouflage-and-sweeper requirement; breakdown.cooldowns carries Heroic Swing at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and Avengerang at 9s rank 1; phases[3].why names the third-hit shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged a fabricated ability name: wants.you[1] wrote 'Heroic Swings'. Two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d), one unsupported magnitude, and a cooldowns field with no number.
audit.why: The ability is Heroic Swing; the bleeds pasted tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.

notes: Every full-layer chart row disagreed with the content layer and the packet; I moved the full sides onto the content values and rewrote each why to match. No paired win[N] edits accompany them because win[N] already holds the target strings — a before==after edit is rejected by the applier. I deliberately did NOT reuse the content layer's claim that Orianna 'outranges Akshan's early Avengerang': Command: Attack is 815 and Avengerang is 850, so that is backwards. Level 1 is still Orianna's on passive autos and the absence of Heroic Swing until 3, and the rewritten phases[0].why says that instead. Left untouched and flagged: report[8].t says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain', but nothing in Akshan's kit text is a heal — Dirty Fighting grants a shield. Grievous Wounds does not answer a shield, so that clause is probably wrong; I did not rewrite it because I cannot source what it was meant to reference. Ratings left as-is throughout: the existing values track difficulty-for-Orianna and I had no grounded basis to renumber them.
